descriptionChirho: To erect or construct a physical structure such as a house, temple, tower, or wall.
To strengthen, encourage, or build up a person or community in faith, used figuratively of spiritual growth and communal encouragement.
To build in a general sense that may encompass either literal construction or figurative edification depending on context, including rebuilding what was torn down.
One who builds, a builder or constructor, used substantively of those engaged in building, especially of the builders who rejected the cornerstone.
